title: TaskSpec
description: A unit of work submitted to an agent. Immutable once submitted (recorded in the task.submitted event).

instruction.description: What to do, in natural language.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the working directory the agent acts in.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checked by the model judge when the agent calls finish.

verify_command.description: Shell command that must exit 0 for the result to be accepted.

context.description: Extra context from the requester (e.g. a parent agent's brief).

Budget.description: Hard ceilings enforced by the kernel before every turn.
